changeinfo.changes: The Swindle 1.01 Day 1 Patch notes: Addition of Cross-Save functionality across "PlayStation 3", "PlayStation 4" and "PlayStation Vita" versions. Minor graphical and performance enhancements.

Bug Fixes: - Improved stability - Improved gameplay controls - Fixed issues with killing a TeslaBot - Fixed a Teleportation issue - Fixed issues with Hacking - Fixed issues with UI - In game economy has been re-balanced - Made improvements on procedurally generated maps - Made changes to Baslisk security
- Fixed spikes being blown up by bombs, but remaining invisible (and deadly). - Renamed trophy description for Stolen Time for clarity. - Fixed stability issues.
